description: This file defines an abstract class 'DefaultCommandHandler' implementing command handling logic, including switch parsing, method invocation, and output handling within the OrchardCore framework.

classes.name: DefaultCommandHandler
classes.description: An abstract class that handles command execution, switch setting, and method invocation for command-line commands within OrchardCore.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Executes a command asynchronously by setting switch values and invoking the command method.

methods.name: SetSwitchValues
methods.description: Sets property values based on command switches.

methods.name: SetSwitchValue
methods.description: Sets a specific property value based on a command switch, with validation for attribute decoration.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Invokes the command method, handling different return types and output.

methods.name: GetInvokeParametersForMethod
methods.description: Prepares method parameters from command arguments for invocation.

methods.name: CheckMethodForSwitches
methods.description: Validates that the method supports the provided switches.

methods.name: ConvertToType
methods.description: Converts a string value to a specified type, handling enums.
